blocks.text: Loop of Henle aur collecting duct se pani wapas lene (reabsorption) ke liye nephrons apne gird ke mayi (surrounding fluid) mein namak (NaCl) ki zyada miqdar banate aur qaim rakhte hain. Yeh kaam counter-current mechanism se hota hai. (Counter-current ka matlab hai ulti simt ka bahao: loop ki ek limb mein mayi neeche jata hai aur doosri mein upar aata hai.)

items: Descending limb se pani guzar sakta hai (permeable) lekin namak nahin.
Ascending limb se pani nahin guzarta (impermeable), lekin yeh active transport se namak ko tubule se bahar nikalti hai.

blocks.text: Jab filtrate descending limb se guzarta hai to pani nikal kar gird ke mayi mein chala jata hai, kyunke gird ke mayi mein namak zyada hai (osmosis). Jab mayi ascending limb se guzarta hai to yeh limb active transport se sodium ions ko filtrate se nikal kar gird ke mayi mein dalti hai. Chloride ions sodium ions ke peeche peeche jate hain. Is tarah gird ke mayi mein namak ki miqdar zyada rehti hai. Jab peshab is namkeen mayi ke beech collecting duct mein neeche jata hai to pani osmosis se bahar nikal kar vasa recta ke zariye khoon mein chala jata hai. Natija: peshab gaarha ho jata hai aur pani bachta hai.

blocks.alt: Peeli nephron nali: Bowman's capsule se pechdaar hissa, phir descending limb neeche, mor, ascending limb oopar aur phir collecting duct mein. Neele teer pani (H2O) ka pechdaar hisse, descending limb aur collecting duct se nikalna dikhate hain; naranji teer ascending limb se Cl- aur Na+ ka nikalna. Chhote kaale teer bahao ki simt hain.

blocks.long_description: Labels: Bowman's capsule, Ascending limb, Descending limb, Collecting duct, H2O (chhe teer), Cl- aur Na+.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Rangon se samjhein: neela teer = pani (H2O) bahar, naranji teer = namak (Na+, Cl-) bahar. Descending limb aur collecting duct sirf pani chhorte hain; ascending limb pani nahi chhorti magar namak bahar pump karti hai. Is tarah aas paas ka mayi namkeen rehta hai aur collecting duct se pani osmosis se nikal kar peshab gaarha ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar tamam nephrons mein loops of Henle na hon to kaisa peshab banega, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Patla peshab: loops ke baghair namkeen medulla nahi banta, is liye collecting ducts se pani kheench kar peshab gaarha nahi kiya ja sakta.

items: Counter-current mechanism gurde ke medulla mein namak (NaCl) ki zyada miqdar banata hai.
Descending limb: pani bahar jata hai, namak nahin. Ascending limb: Na⁺ active transport se bahar (Cl⁻ peeche), pani nahin.
Namkeen mayi collecting duct se pani kheench leta hai; pani vasa recta se khoon mein jata hai aur peshab gaarha hota hai.
